counting.failure_count_evidence: A capture BEGIN without successful END has render count UNKNOWN within [0,2] for implicit or [0,3] explicit, plus previously completed passes. Never replace partial/unknown renderer activity with zero.
counting.request_denominators: planned_attempt_count4; unexecuted_attempt_count=4-len(returned_original_attempts), plus separate started/call/settled/inflight-unknown counters so killed _attempt is not silently called unexecuted. Persist REQUEST_BOUNDARY/ATTEMPT_BEGIN before call and append original attempt before checking. No remaining calls after a failure.

supervision.child: os.fork + setsid after memory-only key input; no credential IPC file/argv/env. Disable cores in parent/child. No descendant workload processes expected.
supervision.allowed_proc_reads: Only current unique child and its actual descendant PID metadata /proc/<pid>/stat and statm for pid/starttime/ppid/pgrp/state/RSS, not cmdline/environ/mem, and no unrelated process content. Pin PID+starttime before kill/reap to avoid reuse; wait4 records kernel rusage.
supervision.sampling: Parent monitors whole owned process group RSS and raw recursive file sizes/free disk/wall at0.2s. Child checkpoint source/settings/budgets before and after each operation. Per-request started/finished journal lets supervisor stop a stuck call after185s without allowing another attempt.
supervision.limits_semantics: Budgets are abort thresholds with finite sampling overshoot; record measured peak and reject if any exceeded. Do not claim mathematically strict RSS/raw containment from sampled supervision.
supervision.cleanup: On threshold/SIGINT/SIGTERM/unexpected child failure kill only owned group TERM, wait2s, KILL if needed and wait4/reap; close/release lock only after owned worker/group exited. Parent cancellation handles cleanup in finally. Never kill Qwen/desktop/unrelated processes. Save supervisor raw rc, reason, observed peak RSS, elapsed, rawbytes, reaped, child identity and final pins. Never print exception text which might contain secret; safe class/hash only.
